name: Rek'Sai - Swarm Queen
texts: When I attack, you may reveal the top 2 cards of your Main Deck. You may play one. Then recycle the rest. If the played card is a unit, you may play it here.
manual: When I attack, you may reveal the top 2 cards of your Main Deck.
If the played card is a unit, you may play it here.
